```{r, include=FALSE}
# Create the DF and merge files

# Remove taxa that was added originally
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
  dplyr::mutate(
    subject_id = factor(subject_id),

    race3 = factor(
      race3,

    ),
    race3 = relevel(race3, ref = "White"),
    ethnicity = factor(
      ethnicity,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Hispanic", "Non-Hispanic")
    ),
    ethnicity = relevel(ethnicity, ref = "Non-Hispanic"),
    Intervention = factor(Intervention)
  )


# After factor conversion
table(ldm_metadata_long$race3, useNA = "ifany")
table(ldm_metadata_long$ethnicity, useNA = "ifany")

ldm_metadata_long %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      c(subject_id, time, sex, race3, ethnicity),
      ~ sum(is.na(.x))
    )
  )
```

```{r}

# Run LDM
# Select microbiome measurements
microbiome <- genus_count_matrix
#controls
covariates <- c("age", "sex", "race3", "ethnicity", "time")

# variables to test
predictors <- c(
  "avg_mvpa",
  "prop_cal_diff_from_rx",
  "M_Energy_kcal"
)

# run LDM
analyses <- setNames(
  lapply(predictors, function(predictor) {

    model_formula <- as.formula(
      paste0(
        "microbiome | (",
        paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),
        ") ~ ",
        predictor
      )
    )

    LDM::ldm(
      formula = model_formula,
      data = ldm_metadata_long,
      cluster.id = subject_id,
      perm.within.type = 'free',
      perm.between.type = "none",
      seed = 10272026,
      n.cores = 1,
      
    )
  }),
  predictors
)
?lapply
# Prints overall microbiome association p-values
lapply(analyses, function(model) model$p.global.omni)
```



```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=14}


# grab predictor, taxon, q values
taxa_results <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  analyses,
  function(model, predictor) {
    tibble(
      predictor = predictor,
      taxon = colnames(model$y.freq),
      q_value = as.numeric(model$q.otu.omni)
    )
  }
)

taxon_order <- taxa_results %>%
  filter(predictor == "avg_mvpa") %>%
  arrange(q_value) %>%
  pull(taxon)

taxa_results <- taxa_results %>%
  mutate(
    taxon = factor(taxon, levels = rev(taxon_order)),
    predictor = factor(predictor, levels = predictors)
  )

n_participants <- n_distinct(ldm_metadata_long$subject_id)
n_samples <- nrow(ldm_metadata_long)


p1 <- ggplot(taxa_results, aes(x = predictor, y = taxon)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = -log10(q_value))) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "red",
    name = "-log10(q)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Microbiome associations",
    subtitle = " MVPA: 148 Participants,  449 samples",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) + 
  theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
    )

p1
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=14}

# Taxa with q < 0.1 for either exposure of interest
filtered_taxa <- taxa_results %>%
  filter(
    predictor %in% c("avg_mvpa", "prop_cal_diff_from_rx"),
    q_value < 0.1
  ) %>%
  pull(taxon) %>%
  unique()

# Keep original results for those taxa
filtered_taxa_results <- taxa_results %>%
  filter(
    predictor %in% c("avg_mvpa", "M_Energy_kcal"),
    taxon %in% filtered_taxa
  )

# Order taxa by MVPA q-value
taxon_order <- filtered_taxa_results %>%
  filter(predictor == "avg_mvpa") %>%
  arrange(q_value) %>%
  pull(taxon)

filtered_taxa_results <- filtered_taxa_results %>%
  mutate(
    taxon = factor(taxon, levels = rev(taxon_order)),
    predictor = factor(
      predictor,
      levels = c("avg_mvpa", "M_Energy_kcal")
    )
  )

# Plot the results
p2 <- ggplot(filtered_taxa_results, aes(x = predictor, y = taxon)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = -log10(q_value))) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "red",
    name = "-log10(q)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Microbiome associations",
    subtitle = "MVPA: 149 Participants, 449 samples",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 24)
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
  )
```

```{r}

# Combine MVPA betas with q-values
mvpa_plot_data <- tibble(
  taxon = colnames(analyses[["avg_mvpa"]]$beta),
  beta = as.numeric(unlist(analyses[["avg_mvpa"]]$beta[1, ]))
) %>%
  left_join(
    taxa_results %>%
      filter(predictor == "avg_mvpa") %>%
      select(taxon, q_value),
    by = "taxon"
  ) %>%
  filter(q_value < 0.1) %>%
  mutate(
    q_group = if_else(
      q_value < 0.05,
      "q < 0.05",
      "0.05 ≤ q < 0.10"
    ),
    taxon = reorder(taxon, beta)
  )

p3 <- ggplot(mvpa_plot_data, aes(x = beta, y = taxon, fill = q_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey40") +
  facet_grid(
    q_group ~ .,
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("red", "blue"),
    name = "q-value"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "MVPA associations with microbial taxa",
    x = "Beta",
    y = "Taxa",
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
    )

p3
```
